ReadingPlan.headline: Bible Reading Plan
ReadingPlan.subtitle: Week 29 (July 27 to August 2)
ReadingPlan.sun_prayer: Beloved Father, thank you so much because when we were dead in our trespasses and sins, You gave us life together with Christ. Thank you that our salvation did not start with us, but in Your mercy, Your great love, and the richness of Your grace. We confess that we often live as if Your acceptance were a wage to be earned, and not a gift received. Forgive us. For by grace we have been saved, through faith, and this is not from ourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast. Father, this week, deliver us from the pride of those who think they saved themselves and the discouragement of those who think they still need to prove themselves before You. We are Your handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which You prepared in advance for us to do. May our obedience not be an attempt to pay for grace, but gratitude in motion. In Jesus' name, amen.

AboutUs.headline: Biblical. Simple. Welcoming.
AboutUs.p1: Our project began in April 2022, with the goal of serving the northern region of São José dos Campos. Since then, we have gathered every Sunday to worship God and grow together.
AboutUs.p2: We believe that a life without Jesus is a life in darkness. We were all lost in our sins, without hope and without God. But because of His great love, He sent Jesus to die in our place on the cross and resurrect, offering us forgiveness and a new life. Christ is the Light — and in Him, we were rescued from darkness.
AboutUs.p3: That is why we are called FAROL! We want to shine the light of Christ in this region, helping people find forgiveness at the foot of the cross, a deep relationship with God through the Bible, and a community of simple people, willing to serve and love one another just as Christ loved us.
AboutUs.mission_text: To be a biblical, simple, and welcoming church that lives faith practically and makes a difference in its community.
AboutUs.vision_text: To glorify God through lives transformed by a growing relationship with Jesus.

Counseling.title: Biblical Counseling
Counseling.intro: No one was meant to carry everything alone. Suffering is a part of life, and often we don't know how to handle it. If you are going through a difficult time — in your marriage, family, work, or within yourself — we want to walk alongside you.
Counseling.what_is_p1: It is a conversation. Serious, careful, and honest. The idea is simple: sitting down with someone who will truly listen to you, understand what is happening in your life, and help you see it in light of what God says.
Counseling.what_is_p2: We believe the Bible is not a rulebook disconnected from real life. It addresses the marriage that has grown cold, the anxiety that keeps you awake, the anger you don't understand, and the grief no one knows how to help you through. And it speaks with hope, because at its center is Jesus — who knows human pain from the inside and doesn't give up on anyone.
Counseling.what_is_p3: At the same time, biblical counseling promises no shortcuts. Real change takes time and happens from the inside out. But you do not have to walk this path alone.
Counseling.how_step1: You reach out. Fill out the form sharing, in a few lines, what is happening. Nothing elaborate — just enough for us to understand your needs.
Counseling.how_step2: We schedule the first meeting. In person at the church or online, whatever works best for you. It lasts about an hour.
Counseling.how_step3: From then on, we walk together. We will schedule other meetings, with readings and tasks in between — simple and practical things, so that what we discuss doesn't stay just a discussion.
Counseling.important_p1: It is completely free. Counseling is not a service we sell — it is part of the care the church exists to offer. You will never pay anything.
Counseling.important_p2: What you share stays between us. Confidentiality is taken seriously here. The only exceptions are life-threatening situations or cases where the law requires reporting — and even then, you would be notified first.

Contribua.title: Give
Contribua.desc1: Farol Baptist Church is sustained by the offerings of its members. This is how we pay the bills, maintain our teaching ministry, care for people, and support the church's ministries.
Contribua.desc2: But if you are not a member here and want to contribute, your offering is very welcome. Perhaps you have been blessed by a sermon, are following the church from afar, or simply want to join in what God is doing here. Contribua.desc3: Giving is not paying for a religious service. It is participating in a work that belongs to God, using what He Himself has placed in our hands.

AboutUs_Home.title: WELCOME!
AboutUs_Home.p1: It is a pleasure for us to welcome you! We hope you feel embraced, loved, and at ease among us. We want you to know more of Jesus here.

Sobre.history_p1: Our project began in April 2022, with the goal of serving the northern region of São José dos Campos. Since then, we have gathered every Sunday to worship God and grow together.
Sobre.history_p2: We believe that a life without Jesus is a life in darkness. We were all lost in our sins, without hope and without God. But because of His great love, He sent Jesus to die in our place on the cross and rise again, offering us forgiveness and new life.
Sobre.history_p3: That is why we are called FAROL (Lighthouse)! We want to shine the light of Christ in this region, helping people find forgiveness at the foot of the cross, a deep relationship with God through the Bible, and a community of simple people, willing to serve and love one another.
Sobre.belief_1: We believe that the Bible (the 39 books of the Old Testament and the 27 books of the New Testament recognized by Evangelical churches) is divinely inspired, inerrant, and infallible (2 Peter 1:19–21), and that the preaching and teaching of the Word are the foundation for the transformation of individuals and the congregation, aimed at glorifying God (John 14:21; 15:7-8, 2 Timothy 3:16-17, James 1:23–25).
Sobre.belief_2: We believe that all creation, including human beings, was made for the praise of the glory of God. The Lord is the center of all things, the only God, Almighty (Psalm 145; Isaiah 6:1–8; Ephesians 1:3–12; Philippians 2:5–11).
Sobre.belief_3: We believe that the family was created by God and has its standards established in Scripture (Genesis 1:26–28; 2:23–24).
Sobre.belief_4: We believe that human beings are sinners from birth, by nature and personal choice (Romans 3:10–12).
Sobre.belief_5: We believe that Jesus Christ was born of a virgin, without sin, died on the cross for our sins, rose from the dead on the third day, and will return again to reign (Acts 10:36–43). We believe He is perfectly God and perfectly man (Colossians 2:8–9; 1 Timothy 2:5).
Sobre.belief_6: We believe that the salvation of human beings is a free gift, granted by the sovereign grace of God and received by faith (Ephesians 2:4–10), secured only by the Person and work of Jesus Christ (Acts 4:12). We believe that once saved, we become children of God and have eternal security (Romans 8:28–39).
Sobre.belief_7: We believe that baptism is the outward affirmation of an inward reality, symbolizing the believer's identification with the death, burial, and resurrection of Christ, and with the Church (Romans 6:3–4), administered to those who have believed in Jesus (Acts 8:35–39).
Sobre.belief_8: We believe that the Lord's Supper is a memorial of the death and resurrection of Jesus, and an announcement of His return (1 Corinthians 11:23–36), participated in by all believers present in communion with their local churches (1 Corinthians 11:27–30).
Sobre.belief_9: We believe that the Church is the community of believers in Jesus, the bride of Christ, His Body on earth (Ephesians 2:19; 5:25–27). The local church is God's agency on earth (Acts 13:1–3), governed by men whom God gave as pastors/elders/bishops (1 Peter 5:1–3).
Sobre.belief_10: We believe that the Holy Spirit is received by every believer at the moment of conversion to Christ, at which time we are baptized/sealed in Him (Ephesians 1:13–14). We believe that spiritual gifts are abilities sovereignly given to believers by the Holy Spirit for the glorification of God and the edification of the Church (1 Corinthians 12:8–11; Romans 1:11–13; 1 Peter 4:10–11).
Sobre.belief_11: We believe that the second coming of Jesus will be personal, physical, and visible (Acts 1:11), and that in the end there will be the creation of new heavens and a new earth, where there will no longer be the presence or possibility of sin (Revelation 19–22).
